exams.name: Written examination for registered professional nursing licensure
exams.notes: The board determines subjects; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination.
exams.quote: The applicant shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the board may determine, which examination may be supplemented by an oral or practical examination or both. Upon successfully passing such examinations the applicant shall be licensed by the board to practice professional nursing.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Required for multistate license under the Nurse Licensure Compact.
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable

exams.name: Written examination for practical nursing licensure
exams.notes: The board determines subjects; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination.
exams.quote: The applicant shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the board may determine, which examination may be supplemented by an oral or practical examination or both. Upon successfully passing such examinations, the applicant shall be licensed by the board to practice practical nursing.

exams.name: Written examination for advanced practice nurse certification
exams.notes: Board may accept proof of current certification from a state with substantially equivalent standards in lieu of its own examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state (New Jersey Board of Nursing) or equivalent national exam
exams.quote: Has passed a written examination approved by the board

interval_years.quote: all professional or occupational licenses or certificates of registration, except such licenses or certificates issued to real estate brokers or salesmen pursuant to chapter 15 of Title 45, which prior to the effective date of this act were issued for periods not exceeding one year and were annually renewable, shall, on and after the effective date of this act, be issued for periods of two years and be biennially renewable

required.quote: It may require licensees to meet continuing education requirements as a condition of relicensure.

period_years.quote: the number of credits of continuing education required of each person licensed as a professional nurse or a practical nurse, as a condition of biennial license renewal

value: 1 credit on prescription opioid drugs, including alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion
1 credit on explicit and implicit bias (for nurses providing perinatal treatment and care)
2 credits on end-of-life care (for advanced practice nurses)
1 credit on cultural competency and implicit bias training (for nurses providing in-home health care services, biennially)
topical_requirements.quote: the number of credits of continuing education required of each person licensed as a professional nurse or a practical nurse, as a condition of biennial license renewal, include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning prescription opioid drugs

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice professional nursing without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered or professional nurse by examination or by original waiver under the laws of another State, territory or possession of the United States, or the District of Columbia, or any foreign country, if in the opinion of the board the applicant has the qualifications required by this act for the licensing of professional nurses, or equivalent qualifications.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid current corresponding license in good standing from another state with substantially equivalent education, training, and examination requirements; must have practiced within the five years prior to application; and must submit to criminal history background check.
requirements.quote: a board shall issue a professional or occupational license, certificate of registration, or certification to any person who documents that the person holds a valid, current corresponding professional or occupational license, certificate of registration, or certification in good standing issued by another state

exists.quote: the New Jersey Board of Nursing shall consist of 12 members, six of whom shall be registered professional nurses, two of whom shall be licensed practical nurses, two of whom shall be nurse educators, one of whom shall be an advanced practice nurse, and one of whom shall be an additional public member

national_certification.value: National accrediting organization certification for APN (approved by the board)
national_certification.quote: Has been certified as a nurse practitioner, clinical nurse specialist or advanced practice nurse by a national accrediting organization, which: (1) is approved by the board; (2) includes pharmacology in its required curriculum; and (3) requires successful completion of a written examination, including pharmacology, of all persons awarded its certificates.

credential_type.quote: Upon successfully passing such examinations the applicant shall be licensed by the board to practice professional nursing.

is_mandatory.quote: After September 1, 1956, to practice or offer to practice professional nursing as defined by this act, unless such person holds an effective, unsuspended license as a registered nurse under this act

title_protection.quote: To represent in any way that such person is a registered nurse or to use after his or her name the abbreviation "R.N." unless such person holds an effective, unsuspended license as a professional nurse under this act

scope_protection.quote: After September 1, 1956, to practice or offer to practice professional nursing as defined by this act, unless such person holds an effective, unsuspended license as a registered nurse under this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate, registration, license, or authorization to sit for an examination through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in gross negligence, gross malpractice, or gross incompetence that damaged or endangered life, health, welfare, safety, or property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice, or incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in professional or occupational misconduct as determined by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of, or engaging in acts constituting, any crime or offense with a direct or substantial relationship to the regulated activity or inconsistent with public health, safety, or welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having authority to engage in the regulated activity revoked or suspended by another state, agency, or authority for reasons consistent with the statute.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or failing to comply with provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging licensee functions in a manner consistent with public health, safety, and welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the insurance fraud prevention law or being adjudicated of such a violation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of P.L.1983, c.320 (C.17:33A-1 et seq.) or any insurance fraud prevention law or act of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use likely to impair ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where substances were to be used for unauthorized purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where the applicant or holder knew or should have known that the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act requiring licensure, or aiding and abetting such unlicensed practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

insurance_required.quote: An applicant shall satisfy or shall have satisfied all applicable prerequisites required for initial licensure in this State, such as obtaining insurance, including malpractice insurance, a surety bond, or a pressure seal.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems, through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems, through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist.

value: provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being
executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist
nursing diagnosis (identification of physical and psychosocial signs and symptoms)
therapeutic treatment measures within the nursing regimen
methods_authorized.quote: diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems, through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice nurses may prescribe or order medications and devices in inpatient and outpatient settings pursuant to joint protocols developed with a collaborating physician. APNs may also dispense narcotic drugs for maintenance or detoxification treatment if they meet federal training and registration requirements. APNs must complete 6 contact hours of CE in pharmacology related to controlled substances as a condition of prescribing controlled dangerous substances.
drug_authority.quote: prescribing or ordering medications and devices, as authorized by subsections b. and c. of this section

license_tiers.quote: The practice of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses... The practice of nursing as a licensed practical nurse is defined as performing tasks and responsibilities within the framework of casefinding... "Advanced practice nurse" means a person who holds a certification in accordance with section 8 or 9 of P.L.1991, c.377

aprn_role_categories.quote: Whenever the titles or designations "nurse practitioner," "clinical nurse specialist" or "nurse practitioner/clinical nurse specialist" occur or any reference is made thereto in any law, contract or document, the same shall be deemed to mean or refer to the title or designation "advanced practice nurse."

value: licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: performing tasks and responsibilities within the framework of casefinding; reinforcing the patient and family teaching program through health teaching, health counseling and provision of supportive and restorative care, under the direction of a registered nurse or licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician or dentist.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: the prescription is written in accordance with standing orders or joint protocols developed in agreement between a collaborating physician and the advanced practice nurse, or pursuant to the specific direction of a physician

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice nurse may prescribe medications and devices in all other medically appropriate settings, subject to the following conditions: (1) the collaborating physician and advanced practice nurse shall address in the joint protocols whether prior consultation with the collaborating physician is required to initiate a prescription for a controlled dangerous substance

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: No person shall practice as an advanced practice nurse or present, call or represent himself as an advanced practice nurse unless certified in accordance with section 8 or 9 of P.L.1991, c.377 (C.45:11-47 or 45:11-48).

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: the collaborating physician and advanced practice nurse shall address in the joint protocols whether prior consultation with the collaborating physician is required to initiate an order for a controlled dangerous substance

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A practitioner shall register to access prescription monitoring information upon initial application for, or renewal of, the practitioner's CDS registration.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: It shall establish and maintain a registry of all individuals who have successfully completed a homemaker-home health aide training and competency evaluation program. The board shall provide for the inclusion in the registry of information about the disqualification of any person from certification as a homemaker-home health aide

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: It shall require that nursing school curricula include, and shall prescribe standards for, the training of registered professional nurses in the supervision of, and the delegation of nursing tasks to, unlicensed assistive personnel, and shall further prescribe standards establishing the criteria for determining those tasks which registered professional nurses may delegate to unlicensed assistive personnel working under their supervision

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The State of New Jersey enacts and enters into the Nurse Licensure Compact with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall establish an Alternative to Discipline Program for board licensees who are suffering from a chemical dependency or other impairment.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: An attending advanced practice nurse may determine and certify the cause of death of the nurse's patient and execute the death certification pursuant to R.S.26:6-8 if no collaborating physician is available to do so and the nurse is the patient's primary caregiver.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: APNs may provide telehealth services while remaining subject to New Jersey Board of Nursing regulation and the same standard of care as in-person settings. Prescription of Schedule II controlled dangerous substances via telehealth requires an initial in-person examination and subsequent in-person visits every three months (with an exception for stimulants prescribed to minors under 18 using real-time two-way audio-video with parental/guardian written consent).
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The prescription of Schedule II controlled dangerous substances through the use of telemedicine or telehealth shall be authorized only after an initial in-person examination of the patient, as provided by regulation, and a subsequent in-person visit with the patient shall be required every three months for the duration of time that the patient is being prescribed the Schedule II controlled dangerous substance.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: the prescription is written in accordance with standing orders or joint protocols developed in agreement between a collaborating physician and the advanced practice nurse, or pursuant to the specific direction of a physician

military_education_credit_required.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall encourage schools of nursing approved by the board to consider granting a nursing student, who served in the United States military, academic credit toward the student's nursing degree for the student's prior training and experience as a Naval Corpsman or Army Medic.
